neighbours.label: the ' R' or '-r' that opens 'race' or 'racing' when the tokenizer splits it (' R'+'ACING', drag'-r'+'ace', foot'-r'+'aces'); other all-caps words and the same compounds with another noun stay low
fire: The sponsor backs MOTORCYCLE RACING and little else.
He won every foot-race at the county fair.
Teen drivers held a drag-race on the old airstrip.
THIS POLICY EXCLUDES BOAT RACING AND SIMILAR EVENTS.
As a boy I ran in several foot-races each summer.
Local farmers held a kind of tractor-race every August.
WE DO NOT COVER AUTO RACING OR STUNT DRIVING.
The film ends with a wild drag-race through town.
quiet: The sponsor backs MOTORCYCLE SAFETY and little else.
He won every pie contest at the county fair.
Teen drivers held a car show on the old airstrip.
THIS POLICY EXCLUDES BOAT TRAVEL AND SIMILAR EVENTS.
As a boy I ran several errands each summer.
Local farmers held a kind of tractor parade every August.
WE DO NOT COVER AUTO THEFT OR STUNT DRIVING.
The film ends with a wild chase through town.
